shots.name: alice-records-progress
shots.caption: Alice records progress on two activities. Nothing has been shared yet.

shots.name: alice-push-question
shots.caption: Push asks first, and names what the team receives — who changed what, and the totals.

shots.name: alice-push-running
shots.caption: The dialog becomes the work: each step reports what it did.

shots.name: alice-push-done
shots.caption: The closing frame, rather than a toast that vanishes.

shots.name: bob-before-joining
shots.caption: Bob opens the app on a different machine. Empty — he has never seen this engagement.

shots.name: bob-join-question
shots.caption: Joining: what is arriving, and from whom.

shots.name: bob-after-join
shots.caption: Bob now holds the whole engagement, including Alice’s progress. Same plan, two machines.

shots.name: bob-records-progress
shots.caption: Bob records his own progress on a different activity: Solution Design at 80%.

shots.name: bob-push-question
shots.caption: Bob shares. The trunk already holds Alice’s work, and a push only adds.

shots.name: alice-after-autosync
shots.caption: Alice pressed nothing. The automatic tick brought Bob’s work across.

shots.name: both-move-alice
shots.caption: Round two: Alice moves one activity…

shots.name: both-move-bob
shots.caption: …and at the same time, Bob moves another.

shots.name: alice-merge-question
shots.caption: Alice pulls with both of them moved. Nothing conflicts — different activities — so it merges.

shots.name: alice-after-merge
shots.caption: Alice keeps her own figure and gains Bob’s. This is the case the merge used to drop.

notes: Alice set Kick-off & Discovery to 60% and Requirements Workshop to 35%
the shared file now holds 1 version(s)
Bob's joining dialog said: ⬇ The trunk is 1 version ahead of you, and you have changed nothing since you last shared.
after pulling, Bob shows Kick-off & Discovery at 60%
after the automatic tick, Alice shows Solution Design at 80%
both then moved at once: Alice Data Mapping → 25%, Bob Integration Testing → 45%
after the merge Alice holds her own 25% and Bob's 45%
